answer: Suppose a farm wants a hundred names by morning. Confirmed recorded delivery agent warrant with delivery agents standing says no: a warrant agents confirm after signature audits stands in the way, and the kernel of each fake is a separate errand in the physical world. A lone clone is affordable; a hundred clones form a company that earns nothing. The sparrow is the line where the farm's ledger goes negative. The shale is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
